Expansion

text.text: FlashArray//M can expand outside the FlashArray//M chassis with 12Gb/s SAS networking. Expansion shelves are available and can be configured with anywhere from 11TB to 180TB in a single shelf, and up to 4 expansion shelves connected to a chassis.

text.text: The FlashArray//M chassis features internal PCIe/NVMe and 12Gb/s SAS networking, enabling ultra-fast connections that provide hot-plug and high-availability of every module, and generations of upgradability. FlashArray//M is NVMe ready and can be upgraded non-disruptively to FlashArray//X.
